summary: Stochastic Consolidation methods now open from the project list, and a new one can be added from a vector row: pick bootstraps from other reserving classes, set their correlations, and read the combined reserve range.
details: The Segments tab lists each included bootstrap with its own mean, standard deviation and CV, and says why a segment cannot be combined.
The Correlation tab edits the target correlations as a mirrored matrix and shows the correlations a run used and achieved.
Consolidate runs the combination without saving; the Results tab shows the range with your chosen percentiles, a distribution chart, a fan chart, and each segment's share and the diversification.
